references.text: Ezek 36:32 specifies the principle of 1 Sam 2:30 that those who despise God will be put to shame, by calling Israel to feel ashamed of their conduct.
Ezek 36:22 illuminates the principle of 1 Sam 2:30 regarding God's honor by showing that God's actions are governed by his holy name, not human merit.
Ezek 20:44 confirms the principle of 1 Sam 2:30 by demonstrating that God's judgment on those who despise him serves to hallow his name.
